headline: Keyboard and mouse controls and adjustable difficulty are released
summary: Keyboard and Mouse reaches 1.1.1, adding WASD movement, mouse camera control, configurable bindings and menu navigation for Ratchet & Clank. Difficulty 1.1.0 exposes multipliers for enemies, damage, speed, prices, ammo, bolts and health. Its presets fill the sliders, while seeded Chaos can vary settings per level.
highlights: Keyboard and Mouse 1.1.0 extends controls to menus, cutscenes and movies. 1.1.1 makes Enter or a click travel on the map.
Difficulty's Easy, Retail, Hard, Brutal and Chaos presets show their values directly in the launcher.
Live Splits 1.0.0 is added to split a running LiveSplit timer when changing planets, excluding death reloads. No release is recorded today.
DualSense mod code is also added, without a recorded release.
